notes.title: Update 0.200
notes.content:
[h2]Update 0.200[/h2]
Welcome to Brisk Square update 0.200!

[b]What's new:[/b]
[olist]
[*] Level system
[*] Upgrade system
[*] New corridor environment
[*] New obstacles
[*] Left hand support
[*] Double start speed settings
[*] News system
[*] Blocking bullet with sword will heat the sword
[*] Blocking bullet will add score points
[*] Reset cooldown zones for telekinesis and arrow
[/olist]

[b]Improvements:[/b]
[olist]
[*] Font change to make text more readable
[*] Games played reset fix
[*] Games skills balancing
[*] Bug fixes
[*] Security fixes
[/olist]

[h2]Upgrade System[/h2]
Learn how the upgrading system works in Brisk Square and how you can earn different Skill Points to level up.
What is brisk square's upgrade system?
Through the upgrading system of Brisk Square you have the possibility to control how you play the game, by upgrading your weapon of choice. 
The skills that can be upgraded through skill points are:

- Arrow
- Slowtime
- Telekinesis
- Sword

[h2]How do I earn skill points?[/h2]
You can earn points by levelling up. The experience you earn while playing the game, which is converted into levels. 
Each time you level up, you will earn a skill point.
The game has in total 420 levels. 
You will earn skill points till level 101 with a total of 100 points.

Information about your current level can be found in the 'Upgradable skills' window.

[h2]New Obstacles[/h2]
We will introduce 2 new obstacles:
Fan: can be stopped by shooting with arrow or throwing objects with telekinesis
Lasers: can be dodged or stop them by shooting with arrow

For more information please join our discord server https://outerlynx.com/discord/
